summary: PRA Group filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a Second Amended and Restated European Credit Agreement by its subsidiary, PRA Group Europe Holding. The amendment extends the maturity of the existing €730 million revolving credit facility from November 2027 to April 2031 and reduces the maximum ERC ratio from 45% to 40%. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation event is present; this is a routine refinancing of an existing credit facility. The filing is a standard disclosure of a material definitive agreement and associated financial obligation.
